body:
As a stressed-out, middle-aged woman I am always on the lookout for a safe and effective herbal tonic that will bring some peace of mind. I am not interested in the least in trying anything dangerous or mind-bending as I have too many responsibilities and concerns for my health. I'm no tripper.
I have been taking a regimine of 5HTP, Vinpocetine, Osha extract, and Holy Basil for a few months, and feeling pretty good. But having developed some new concerns about my eyesight, I did some research and bought some Bilberry extract at the local market. All I can say is wow! This must be the world's best kept secret. I take what is recommended on the label, about a dropper full three times daily between meals, and every time I drink it, I feel true inner peace, bordering on a nice high, but with a sense of security. As in the world is something I can navigate through and enjoy.
